consistency_internal.explantion: Both responses exhibit blurred viewpoints, unresolved conflicts, false consensus, and attribution failures, but Response a makes a modest attempt to separate men’s perceived experience of feminism from the movement’s stated goals (e.g., distinguishing ‘perception’ from ‘intended benefit’).
